videos.titulo: Soda Can Bottom: Why It Curves Inward
videos.descripcion:
A soda can wall is about 0.1 mm thick but holds up to roughly 90 psi. The domed bottom works like an arch, resisting the pressure with less metal than a flat bottom would need.

Sources: The Christian Science Monitor, The surprising science behind the aluminum soda can (csmonitor.com) · 99% Invisible (99percentinvisible.org) · US patents on domed can bottoms.
